baseline.method: Raindoss Fringe official NumPy backend, 100 forward/reverse sweeps; author existing simulations

nrmse_definition: RMS complex error after optimal constant phase alignment, divided by reference amplitude dynamic range. Extreme overflow-sized errors saturate at 1e300.
alignment: One constant unit phase minimizes complex L2 difference; no translation, spatial phase, crop or intensity rescaling.
amplitude_residual_definition: L2 mismatch of all eight predicted normalized amplitudes divided by measured normalized amplitude L2 norm; no fitted scale.
